create_HabitatSim_sensor: create a HabitatSimRGBSensor or HabitatSimDepthSensor with a config to get visual observations from the simulator
overwrite_config_HabitatSim: overwrite a Habitat-Sim config structure with Habitat Lab config values using the overwrite_config function
run_HabitatSim_reset_step: run the HabitatSim simulator by calling reset to initialize then step with an action to get observations
get_observations_at_pose: get sensor observations at a specific position and rotation without permanently moving the agent
compute_geodesic_distance: compute the geodesic distance between two positions in the scene using the HabitatSim pathfinder
